actual.notes: express 5.2.1 hoisted at the root of a yarn 4 workspace, so one directory is the whole swap. webpack-dev-server keeps an express 4 of its own that the server tests never load, hence the exclude. Their tests send a body with GET and DELETE, which Express reads on any verb and this project reads only for POST, PUT, PATCH and QUERY unless told: `body methods` says so here, so that what is compared is everything else.

librechat.notes: express 5.2.1 hoisted at the root of the npm workspace. The api tests bring their own mongod through mongodb-memory-server, so nothing has to be installed for them. The api tests import @librechat/api and the other workspace packages from their dist, so those are built first or 212 of the 232 suites fail on the import alone. Their DELETE routes take a JSON filter in the body, which Express reads on any verb: `body methods` says so here too.
